name: Iridic-Gibber
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait towering mountain ranges, and everything the light never reaches.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
